paper_title: A Telescope Search for Decaying Relic Axions
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, converted from the paper's xi = (4/3)(E/N - 1.92) via g = (alpha/(2pi f_a))*(3/4)*xi with f_a = 5.7e6 GeV / m_a[eV]
notes: Telescope search for optical line emission from two-photon decay of thermal relic axions in galaxy clusters A2667 and A2390 (VIMOS IFU at VLT). Table I gives 95% CL upper limits on the dimensionless two-photon coupling parameter xi = (4/3)(E/N - 1.92) over 4.5-7.7 eV: xi = 7.17e-3 (4.5 eV), 9.00e-3 (5 eV), 5.72e-3 (6 eV), 4.60e-3 (6.5 eV), 3.41e-3 (7 eV), 2.95e-3 (7.5 eV), 2.47e-3 (7.65 eV). I converted these to g_agamma using the standard QCD axion m_a-f_a relation (m_a*f_a = 5.7e6 eV*GeV); if downstream prefers raw xi values, divide out the factor 1.528e-10 * m_a[eV]. Limits assume the standard thermal freeze-out abundance Omega_a h^2 = m_a,eV/130 (cosmological abundance, not a local halo DM density). Gaps near m_a = 5.43 and 4.83 eV (sky lines at 5577 A and 6300 A) where no useful limits exist. Table II cross-correlation limits are ~1.5x weaker and not used. The RDCS 1252 discussion (8-14 eV) is only a projection and was excluded.
